summary: Pre-release gate testing (backend + Expo web UI at 375x667). UPLOADS OK: we drove the real UI with Playwright file chooser (expo-image-picker web fallback). Single add went Wardrobe -> + -> library -> AI analysis filled name/colour -> saved, piece shown in grid. Bulk Add with 4 photos showed progress, per-photo results and '4 pieces added'. Retry of failures (forced 500 on /capture) went from 0 added + 'Retry failed items' to 2 added. Grid images rendered (base64, naturalWidth 320). Item detail, edit and delete all work, and Shop-check photo upload works. GATED: /packing, /capsule, /tryon, /planner, /looks (also /looks?tab=history, /planner/, history.pushState) all redirect to Home. A MutationObserver saw no flash of feature content, the app made no gated API calls and there were no console errors. No in-app link to these screens exists (static grep plus UI walk). All 10 gated endpoints return 404 {detail:'Not Found'} with and without auth, the same as an unknown path, with no data or stack leak. Minor fingerprinting is possible through 422 (malformed JSON) and 405 (wrong method). RELEASED: Home + weather, all 6 wardrobe categories down to item level, Create Outfit + Check My Outfit, Dress Me (generate, create another look, discard, wear this today), AI Stylist (reply, New Chat, reopen thread), Collections -> Saved/Worn, Outfits tab + detail, Wardrobe Health, Shopping Intelligence, Profile (membership row, privacy, terms) and back navigation all work. Free 100-cap behaves in the UI: wardrobe-full card, add-item full screen and bulk 'Free wardrobe is full'; API returns 402 with count staying 100. A new signup gets complimentary 7-day Premium. Issues found: unreleased Planner is still ADVERTISED in onboarding and paywall copy, a pre-existing premium-hydration race, and reviewer demo-wardrobe behaviour. No deprecated Expo packages were found (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

minor.issue: With a malformed JSON body these return 422 json_invalid instead of 404, because FastAPI parses the body before the route-level unreleased() dependency runs. An unknown path would return 404, so this shows the route exists. No data leaks.

These return 405 Method Not Allowed instead of 404, which also shows the gated routes exist. The routes are still listed in the internal /openapi.json. The public /api/openapi.json and /api/docs return 404, which is good. Suggested fix: do not register the gated routes at all (wrap the decorators in `if feature not in UNRELEASED_FEATURES`), or add a path-prefix middleware that returns 404 before routing.

These still read db.plans (server.py:2567, 2592, 3594). Plans created before the gate (2 in this DB, 0 in the future) can still set the Dress Me occasion, and the user has no UI to see or delete them. Low impact.
Pre-existing: this endpoint does not exist (405), so 'Wear this today' cannot be undone through the API or UI. FYI only.

ui_bugs.issue: Pre-existing, not from this change. Right after a page load, tapping 'Wardrobe Health' (profile.tsx:177) or the Shop upload (shop.tsx:34) sends a PREMIUM user (review@aureve.app) to /premium. After about 5 seconds the same tap works. RCA: usePremiumAccess() returns premium=false until user/profile hydrate, and the onPress handlers route to the paywall instead of waiting for hydration.

integration_issues.flow: Unauthenticated deep link to a gated route
integration_issues.issue: The gate uses <Redirect href="/(tabs)" />, which skips app/index.tsx's auth check. A signed-out user opening /packing lands on a signed-out Home with 401 console errors instead of Welcome. The same gap already exists for /wardrobe (no auth guard in (tabs)/_layout). Suggest Redirect href="/" so index.tsx decides between welcome and tabs.

app/premium.tsx:17: FEATURES bullet 'Occasion planning' is sold as a Premium benefit, but Planner is unreachable. Remove or reword both before the Play submission.

Pre-existing: when the reviewer adds any real piece, show_demo flips to false (server.py:209-215) and all 16 demo items disappear. On the next backend restart, seed_reviewer_account() deletes them for good (server.py:4291-4305). A Play reviewer who tests upload will see the wardrobe empty out. Confirmed during this run: the item was deleted straight away and all 16 demo items came back, with no restart in between.

react_native_issues.issue: This cannot be checked from web. The expo-image-picker config plugin is not listed in app.json plugins, and blockedPermissions only covers READ_MEDIA_IMAGES and READ_MEDIA_VIDEO. After the next build, check the final AAB permissions (aapt dump permissions or the Play Console) to confirm that no other library adds READ_MEDIA_* or READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE without maxSdkVersion. Reference: /app/frontend/app.json:30-38
The Metro log warns that expo@54.0.35 (expected ~54.0.37), expo-constants@18.0.13 (~18.0.14) and expo-file-system@19.0.23 (~19.0.24) are behind. Align them before the release build.

action_items: Remove or reword the unreleased-Planner copy: onboarding.tsx slide 3 ('Plan Your Week... Create outfits in advance') and premium.tsx:17 'Occasion planning'.
Change the gate redirects in packing/capsule/tryon/planner/looks.tsx from href="/(tabs)" to href="/" so signed-out deep links reach Welcome/Login.
Optional hardening: register gated FastAPI routes only when the feature is released, or 404 them in middleware, so malformed bodies and wrong methods also return 404 instead of 422/405.
Pre-existing: make Premium-gated onPress handlers (profile open-health-report/open-shopping-intelligence, shop upload/analyse) wait for user/profile hydration before routing to /premium.
Pre-existing: consider stopping reviewer demo items from vanishing or being purged after the reviewer adds one real piece.
After the next Android build, check the merged AAB permission list.
critical_code_review_comments: The gate pattern (early return of <Redirect> in a wrapper, then the original body in a second component) keeps hook order valid. No Rules-of-Hooks violation.
No released screen calls a gated endpoint (grep across app/ and src/).
image.ts: the Android branch returns 'granted' with no permission call. The camera path still requests CAMERA as before. iOS and web paths are unchanged and verified on web.
server.py is 4375 lines, well over the 700-line guideline (pre-existing).

rca_of_issue: Premium race: usePremiumAccess() reads user.premium and active profile from context; on cold start, before /auth/me and profiles resolve, premium is false, so the onPress handlers push /premium. Gate fingerprint: FastAPI parses the JSON body (json_invalid -> 422) and method matching (405) before route dependencies run, so a dependency-based 404 cannot cover these cases.
